pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Opens a wheel of stations: crafting table, furnace, enchanting table, brewing stand, smoker, blast furnace, anvil, smithing table, stonecutter, grindstone, cartography table and loom. A station opens its vanilla window without a block.$(br2)$(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() all three Paths, level 3.

pages.title: Stations and pages
pages.text: Stations sit on three pages of four. The first page is open at once, the others cost experience levels; the Nth station costs N levels. Buy with Shift+click on a locked station or on the wheel centre. The centre turns pages: left click for next, right click for previous. Rearrange stations in the progression menu, Placement section.

pages.title: Furnaces and the stand
pages.text: The furnace, smoker, blast furnace and brewing stand keep their items, fuel and progress and keep working in the background with the window closed. Each has its own queue. A marker glows by the slot when finished items wait inside; reopen the station to take them. Enchanting here is always at maximum level (10, 20 and 30). Other stations, as in vanilla, return items when the window closes.

External stations. In the progression menu (H), Vault section, the External Stations item lets you add a station block from another mod: it appears on the wheel like a normal one. An Akashic Chronicles book can be added the same way (needs the Akashic Records mod): the station opens its window and you do not need to hold the book. Clicking an occupied cell returns the item.
